assumptions: Forecast only; token quantities are hypothetical across all agent calls for one completed task.
All input charged at uncached default-context rate; output includes any reasoning tokens; no separate cache-write estimate.
Model rate is GitHub's listed USD per 1,000,000 tokens; real billing can vary with caching, context tier, provider and retries.
Developer may iterate multiple times; token budgets cover expected iterations, not an unlimited autonomous run.
Active agent time is wall-clock approximation, not measured performance; human approvals and slow external dependencies excluded.

small.description: Copy/form change or isolated low-risk helper with unit + BDD check

medium.description: Java API/bug fix, Feature Map/Cucumber, integration checks

large.description: High-risk financial state/authorization, multi-system data and independent dual review
